primitives.name: Holonomy-Residue Isomorphism
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Proposition 1 (Holonomy ↔ residuals).** For abelian A, Hol_γ_i = I iff r_i = 0.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'r_i': 'dimensionless cycle residual (mod 2\\pi)', '\\theta_e': 'edge angle (phase)', '\\gamma_i': 'oriented cycle basis', 'A': 'compact abelian structure group'}
primitives.assumptions: Finite connected graph G, compact abelian structure group A (U(1) or SO(2)), flat connection over cycles.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-zero residue signals non-trivial holonomy, indicating topological obstruction to global section existence.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between topological obstruction (non-trivial holonomy) and algebraic solvability (non-vanishing residue) of the connection.
layer2.telemetry: Cycle-residual variance as empirical proxy for holonomy flag.

primitives.name: CRC-Flat Section Existence
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Proposition 2 (Sections).** If the connection is CRC-flat and stalks are R^d with identity (or compatible) restrictions after gauge fixing θ=0, then dim H0 = d · #{connected components}.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'H0': 'space of global sections (degree 0 cohomology)', 'd': 'rank of stalks (vector space dimension)', 'θ': 'edge angle (gauge-fixed to 0)'}
primitives.assumptions: Compact abelian structure group A, CRC-flat connection, stalks trivialized by gauge choice θ=0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Non-flat connections yield H0 = 0, reflecting topological absence of global parallel frames.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between flatness (vanishing curvature) and existence of globally constant sections, linking differential geometry to sheaf cohomology.
layer2.telemetry: Dimension of H0 as diagnostic for section existence.

primitives.name: Minimum Edit Set Surgery
primitives.verbatim_quote: A minimal |S| is a minimum edit set for the linear system Cθ ≡ 0 (mod 2π) (cycle-edge incidence).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'set of edited edges (subset of total edge set E)', 'r_i': 'cycle residual (mod 2\\pi)', 'Cθ ≡ 0 (mod 2π)': 'cycle-edge incidence linear system'}
primitives.assumptions: Finite graph, compact abelian group, linear system derived from cycle-edge incidence matrix.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Minimal set S achieving flatness corresponds to solution of underdetermined linear equations modulo 2π.

layer2.mapping: Equivalence between combinatorial graph surgery and algebraic linear system solution, both targeting vanishing cycle residues.
layer2.telemetry: Size of minimal feedback edge set as upper bound for required edits.

primitives.name: Relative CRC Failure Mode
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Proposition 4 (Relative CRC).** Let x be stalk values on systems excluding SoT, with CRC-flat maps among them and energy E(x)=0.
primitives.assumptions: CRC-flat internal maps, zero energy implies consistency within subsystems but not necessarily against ledger.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Large value difference ||x - x_ref|| with non-vanishing residues indicates systematic misalignment.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphism between geometric flatness (vanishing curvature) and logical consistency (zero energy), detecting mismatches between local data and global ledger.
layer2.telemetry: Residual variance combined with value differences flags ledger inconsistencies.
